$comment: Source of truth for docs/partners/big-tech-programs.md. Record a submission with npm run programs -- --log <id> --action "...", a benefit with npm run programs -- --benefit <id> --name "...", then the doc rebuilds itself. Never set status member without proof (acceptance email, portal, or live listing). Never store organization, workspace, or account IDs here.
